title: A Himalayan rock-ice avalanche wobbled for months before outrunning every warning
summary: Hundreds of satellite images show the hanging glacier above the collapse accelerating from late 2025, but the signal was found only afterwards — and the river sensors and SMS alerts in place were built for slow monsoon floods, not a 160km/h flow that reached the border in 7.5 minutes.
